q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
The Q2 FY2027 earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026. Today is August 17, 2026. That gives us **9 days** until the announcement.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The current research provides a very specific data point: **NVIDIA has already issued forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 of $91.0 billion ± 2%** (released May 20, 2026, for their Q1 FY2027 earnings).

This guidance range is:
- **$89.18 billion** (lower bound: 91.0 × 0.98)
- **$92.82 billion** (upper bound: 91.0 × 1.02)

Since we are only 9 days away from the earnings release on August 26, 2026, NVIDIA's actual forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 should already be locked in. The guidance provided in the current research ($91.0B ± 2%) is the official forward guidance that will be stated in the August 26 earnings release.

The resolution criteria simply asks: "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)" — this is asking for the specific revenue guidance number NVIDIA provides on August 26.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- A significant deterioration in demand or data center bookings between May and August 2026
- Unexpected macroeconomic headwinds or customer delays
- Supply chain disruptions affecting the Blackwell or Rubin ramp
- Geopolitical developments (China export restrictions) that were not previously anticipated

However, with only 9 days to resolution and guidance already issued, NVIDIA would need to revise guidance downward, which is relatively uncommon and would require material negative news.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected demand for Blackwell and Rubin platforms
- UBS's bullish view ($94-95B range for Q2 actual results, with higher Q3 guidance of $107-108B) might influence NVIDIA to raise forward guidance
- Accelerated customer adoption or larger AI infrastructure investments
- Favorable macro environment supporting enterprise spending

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides NVIDIA's own official guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027, released on May 20, 2026. This is the most reliable and direct data available, not a historical base rate but the actual announced target.

---

## Reasoning Summary

With only 9 days until the August 26, 2026 earnings release, NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 is virtually certain to be the $91.0 billion ± 2% range already publicly announced. Companies rarely make substantial guidance revisions in such a short window unless extraordinary circumstances emerge (major customer delays, geopolitical shocks, etc.).

The range translates to $89.18B - $92.82B with a midpoint of $91.0B. The distribution should be tightly centered around this already-stated guidance. Given that the guidance has a stated tolerance of ±2%, I'll model the probability distribution with a tight concentration around $91.0B, with some tail risk for potential revision.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, is **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**. This outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance is above the average analyst estimate of $86.84 billion [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

While NVIDIA's own guidance for Q2 FY2027 is $91 billion, UBS analysts are predicting a higher revenue for the just-ended quarter, in the range of $94-95 billion, and are expecting NVIDIA to guide the October quarter (Q3 FY2027) to $107-108 billion [aliteq.com](https://aliteq.com/nvidia-q2-fy27-earnings-preview-ubs-2026/). This more bullish outlook is driven by steady demand for Blackwell and an unexpectedly fast ramp-up of the next-generation Rubin platform [aliteq.com](https://aliteq.com/nvidia-q2-fy27-earnings-preview-ubs-2026/). NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026 [aliteq.com](https://aliteq.com/nvidia-q2-fy27-earnings-preview-ubs-2026/).
